method.model: Bradley-Terry strengths fit by MM iteration on non-mirror games
method.bt_regulariser: 1 virtual win + 1 virtual loss vs an average opponent (strength 1 = geometric mean, renormalised every MM step)
method.strength_scale: geometric mean of strengths = 1; expected(a beats b) = s_a / (s_a + s_b)
method.estimate: posterior mean of Beta(k*expected + wins, k*(1-expected) + losses)

evidence.counter: n >= 20, posterior interval excludes expected by > 0.02, |est - 0.5| >= 0.1

method.raw_wr_gate: raw_wr is null below 20 games (wins and n always present)
method.consistent_with_strength: pairs with n >= 20 whose raw 95% Wilson interval contains the strength-model expectation
